description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to deep copying objects within the Orleans serialization framework, including providers, copiers, contexts, and utility classes.

classes.name: ShallowCopier
classes.description: A singleton class for creating shallow copies of objects that are shallow-copyable.

classes.name: ShallowCopier<T>
classes.description: A generic class for creating shallow copies of objects of type T.

classes.name: CopyContext
classes.description: Provides context for deep copy operations, tracking object references to prevent duplication and support recursive copying.

classes.name: CopyContextPool
classes.description: A pool managing reusable instances of CopyContext to optimize performance during multiple copy operations.

methods.name: GetDeepCopier
methods.description: Retrieves a deep copier for a specified type.

methods.name: TryGetDeepCopier
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a deep copier for a specified type without throwing if unavailable.

methods.name: GetBaseCopier
methods.description: Retrieves a base type copier for a specified class type.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object of type T within a given context.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the copying context, clearing tracked object references.

methods.name: RecordCopy
methods.description: Records an object and its deep copy in the context for reference tracking.
